headline: Margins expand and buybacks lift earnings despite flat sales
summary_short: BorgWarner's Q2 FY2026 revenue was essentially flat y/y at $3,648M, but gross margin expanded to 19.8% from 17.6% and net income attributable to BorgWarner rose 23.7% to $277M, with diluted EPS up 30.1% to $1.34 on the combination of margin gains and a smaller share count from buybacks.
summary_long: Net sales were flat y/y ($3,648M vs $3,638M): FX added $54M and tariff recoveries added $11M, offset by $55M of unfavorable volume/mix led by Battery Energy Systems' decline. Gross margin rose 220bp to 19.8% on purchasing savings and cost efficiencies outpacing FX inflation. Drivetrain & Morse Systems and PowerDrive Systems grew; Turbos & Thermal Technologies fell 3% on weaker Europe demand. Net income attributable to BorgWarner rose 23.7% to $277M despite the tax rate climbing to 22% from 18%. Diluted EPS grew faster (+30.1%) as diluted shares fell to 203.0M from 216.3M on $101M of Q2 buybacks; the board added $1B to the repurchase authorization in July 2026. Dividend held at $0.17/share. No numeric 2026 guidance was reissued.

drivers.explanation: FX +$54M and tariff recoveries +$11M offset by $55M unfavorable volume/mix, mainly a Battery Energy Systems decline.
Margin rose to 19.8% from 17.6% on purchasing savings, restructuring/depreciation savings and manufacturing efficiencies outpacing FX cost inflation.
Up 23.7% despite the tax rate rising to 22% from 18%; mix shifted toward higher-margin Drivetrain & Morse and PowerDrive Systems.
Grew faster than net income (+30.1% vs +23.7%) because diluted share count fell to 203.0M from 216.3M on $101M of Q2 buybacks.
Flat top line masks margin expansion and buyback-driven EPS growth; Battery Energy Systems keeps shrinking while core segments improve.
